finding.title_ko: Director 요청 자료에 같은 기록이 두 번 실린다 (전문 record + 꼬리 state·threads·knowledge)
finding.old_text:
state: slot('state'),
      threads: slot('threads'),
      knowledge: slot('knowledge'),
finding.evidence: director.ts:105 가 `record: personBlock(... mode:'record')` 로 인물 기록 전문을 싣는데 (inject.ts:109-156 이 Current state / Knows / Open threads / Suspicion / 기능 칸을 모두 출력), 106-109행이 같은 항목의 마지막 6개씩을 `state`·`threads`·`knowledge`·`suspicion` 으로 또 싣는다. 지침도 basetext.ts:7 에서 「Each person's full record is in `record`; read it whole rather than the summary fields」 라고 꼬리 칸을 쓰지 말라고 한다. 11-07 E 에서 꼬리 → 전문으로 바꾸며 꼬리를 남긴 것. Director 는 기본 설정(director='facts')에서 매 턴 호출. 추정: 인물당 상태 3·지식 6·미해결 3 항목(각 50자 안팎)이면 인물당 약 400토큰, 장면 인물 3명이면 턴당 약 1,200토큰 중복 (추정치, 실측 아님).
finding.also_change: 109행 `suspicion: slot('suspicion')` 도 같은 중복이라 함께 뺀다. 127행 재사용 열쇠(key)는 p.state·p.threads 를 쓰므로, 꼬리 값은 열쇠 계산용 지역 변수로만 남기고 data 에는 넣지 않는다. basetext.ts:7 의 ` rather than the summary fields` 는 지운다. `slots`(기능 칸, 칸 id 로 찾는 용도)는 APPLY 절이 id 로 가리키므로 그대로 둔다.

verdict.reasoning:
Confirmed in the files. director.ts:105 puts the full person block in `record` (personBlock mode 'record'), and inject.ts:109-112, 149-152 print "Current state", "Knows", "Open threads" and (when suspicion is numeric) "Suspicion" from the same slots. director.ts:106-109 then sends the last 6 entries of the same slots again as `state` / `threads` / `knowledge` / `suspicion`. The comment at director.ts:84 says the 11-07 change replaced the tails by the full record, but the tails were left in. basetext.ts:7 tells the model to read `record` whole "rather than the summary fields", so the tails are declared unused by the guide itself. No guide section (basetext.ts, director.ts FEATURE_GUIDE, director-extra.txt) refers to these four fields by name; the only code use is the reuse key at director.ts:127 (p.state, p.threads).

Director default is 'facts' (settings.ts:21), so this goes out every turn where a scene person exists.

Severity lowered to medium: the saving is the finder's estimate, not measured, and depends on how full the records are. Each tail is at most 6 entries of up to 300 chars per slot; early in a chat it is tens of tokens, in a long chat with 2-3 people it can pass 300 tokens per call.

One point against: the record is trimmed to recordCap (>= 1500 chars per person, inject.ts:85-96, order history -> knowledge -> behavior -> scene -> threads, oldest first), while the tails are untrimmed. Only when a record is so over budget that knowledge or threads are cut below 6 entries do the tails carry something the record lacks. State is never trimmed. With blockCap minimum 4000 this is a rare edge case and does not justify sending the duplicate every turn.

The finder's new_text (delete 3 lines) alone would not compile: line 127 reads p.state / p.threads, and noUnusedLocals is on (tsconfig.json:7) so the `slot` helper at line 88 must go too. The final edit below removes all four tail lines; the companion edits are in side_effects.

finding.title_ko: 사실형 Director(기본값)에서 출력 꼴이 react 를 쓰라고 보여 주지만 프로그램은 버린다
finding.old_text: "react":"<≤400 chars or omit>"
finding.new_text: "react":"<≤400 chars, only when `react` is defined above; else omit>"
finding.evidence: OUTPUT 절은 사실형·연출형 공용이다 (director.ts:121). `react` 설명(DIRECTOR_SCENE)은 연출형일 때만 붙고(director.ts:121 `s.director === 'scene' ? [scene] : []`), 읽을 때도 `const react = scene ? plain(n.react, NOTE_CHARS) : ''` (director.ts:178, host/people.ts:671 scene = director==='scene') 라 사실형에서는 react 를 통째로 버린다. now·must_not_reveal 없이 react 만 쓴 메모는 메모 자체가 사라진다(director.ts:181). 기본 설정이 director='facts' (settings.ts:21) 이고 APPLY 절들이 「이번 턴 방향」을 요구하므로 모델이 react 에 써서 잃기 쉽다. 출력 토큰도 인물당 최대 400자 낭비.
finding.also_change: director.ts:34 의 내장 OUTPUT 글(절이 없을 때 쓰는 사본)도 같은 문장으로.

verdict.reasoning:
Confirmed from the files. src/data/guides/director-extra.txt:12 (OUTPUT section) holds the quoted text verbatim, and the same string is the built-in copy at src/core/people/director.ts:34. The OUTPUT section is appended in both modes (director.ts:121), while the only definition of `react` (DIRECTOR_SCENE, src/core/people/basetext.ts:14) is added only when s.director === 'scene'. The parser drops react in facts mode: `const react = scene ? plain(n.react, NOTE_CHARS) : ''` (director.ts:178), called with scene = settings.director === 'scene' (src/host/people.ts:671). A note carrying only react is discarded entirely (director.ts:181). The default is director: 'facts' (src/core/people/settings.ts:21).

So in the default mode the output shape offers a field that is never defined and is always thrown away. The APPLY.* sections (e.g. SUSPICION "Give a concrete direction for this turn", AFFINITY "say concretely how affinity alters conduct") push the model toward direction text, and react is the obvious place to put it.

I rate it low rather than medium. The shape already says "or omit", and the facts text says "Facts, not direction" and "Never propose ... next actions", so a capable model mostly leaves react out. The realistic cost is occasional wasted output (up to 400 chars per person) and, rarely, a note lost because the direction went only into react. I did not run the model to measure how often this happens.

The proposed edit is minimal, stays in English, adds no new rule (it only scopes an existing field), breaks no marker or placeholder, and conflicts with no owner decision. I stand behind it as proposed.

Not fixed by this edit (separate finding): DIRECTOR_SCENE says react is ≤120 chars while OUTPUT and the parser (NOTE_CHARS) say 400.
verdict.final_old_text: "react":"<≤400 chars or omit>"
verdict.final_new_text: "react":"<≤400 chars, only when `react` is defined above; else omit>"
verdict.side_effects:
1) Make the same replacement in the built-in copy at src/core/people/director.ts:34 (const OUTPUT), which is used when the section is missing.
2) tests/guide-out.test.mjs will fail until tests/fixtures/guide-out-old.json is updated: line 175 (the Director OUTPUT section text) and the pinned director.system / director.repair / director.pass2 entries (lines 431-433) all contain the old string.
3) No parser change is needed; scene mode still reads react.
4) An alternative that touches code instead of text: build OUTPUT without the react field when s.director !== 'scene'. It is cleaner but not required.

finding.evidence: 기본 설정(director='facts', director_features='1', settings.ts:21·28)에서 한 요청에 같이 들어간다. FACTS: basetext.ts:7 「Facts, not direction」, :10 「Never propose dialogue, emotion, next actions, plot or outcomes」. 반면 director-extra.txt:22 APPLY.AFFINITY 「then say concretely how affinity alters conduct in this scene: more attention, asking first…」, :42 APPLY.SUSPICION 「Give a concrete direction for this turn … test a detail, or confront」, :52 APPLY.RHYTHM 「If a hook action is allowed, propose at most one … saying what would enter the scene」, :32 APPLY.PERCEPTION 「note a disclosure that could genuinely occur as a future option」. 사실형에는 방향을 담을 칸(react)도 없다. 둘 다 따를 수 없다. 고치는 길은 둘: (가) 위 문장처럼 FACTS 에 예외를 한 구절 넣기, (나) 사실형에서는 APPLY 절의 방향 문장을 빼기(코드). 어느 쪽이 뜻에 맞는지 사용자 결정 필요.

verdict.reasoning:
The contradiction is real and both passages go to the same model in the same request under default settings.

- Defaults: director='facts', director_features='1', and affinity, perception, suspicion and rhythm are all '1' (src/core/people/settings.ts:21,28,53,55,62).
- Assembly: buildDirector (src/core/people/director.ts:117-121) builds system = FACTS + (SCENE only when director==='scene') + APPLY.* for every enabled feature + SEARCH + OUTPUT.
- FACTS (src/core/people/basetext.ts:7,10): "Facts, not direction" and "Never propose dialogue, emotion, next actions, plot or outcomes."
- APPLY sections (src/data/guides/director-extra.txt): line 22 AFFINITY "say concretely how affinity alters conduct in this scene"; line 42 SUSPICION "Give a concrete direction for this turn ... test a detail, or confront"; line 52 RHYTHM "propose at most one ... saying what would enter the scene"; line 32 PERCEPTION "note a disclosure that could genuinely occur as a future option".
- In facts mode the parser discards `react` (director.ts:178, `scene ? plain(n.react) : ''`), so the only place a direction can land is `now`, which FACTS defines as "Facts, not direction".

I rate it medium, not high: the model is not told anything false, and a capable model usually lets the specific section win over the general ban. The cost is uneven notes from turn to turn.

The finder's edit works, but its wording ("the conduct tendency or single proposal") enumerates cases. I would stand behind a shorter clause with the same effect.
